{{Quote|When we arrived at the bombed-out ruins of Mygeeto, our Jedi Commander believed we had been sent to take out a droid energy collector. What Ki-Adi-Mundi didn't know however, was that our unit of the 501st was really after an experimental Mygeetan power source, that the Chancellor wanted for his superlaser.|Entry from the [[501st Journal]]|<ref name="BFII">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>}}
'''Hammertong''' was the codename given to a secret project, known as '''Project Hammertong''', involving the [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] prime weapons for the [[Death Star/Legends|Death Stars]].

Originating during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] was working on their [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Ultimate Weapon]],<ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref> a project which would later be turned over to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and converted into the Death Star project.

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] sent a unit of the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] [[Battle of Mygeeto|to]] [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]]. The official story was that the unit was sent to support the [[Galactic Marines/Legends|Galactic Marines]] under [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] by destroying an energy collector. In truth, the unit was sent to retrieve an [[energy crystal]], used in one of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan's]] power generators, that was necessary for the Hammertong project. [[General/Legends|General]] Mundi was suspicious of the unit's activities but had no idea of the truth until it was [[Order 66/Legends|too late]].<ref name="BFII" />

==Mistryl involvement==
By the time that the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|original Death Star]] was entering service in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the Hammertong project, now led by a scientist named [[Eloy]], was already working on a superlaser design for the [[Death Star II/Legends|second]], even more powerful battlemoon. A prototype section of the prime weapon was constructed in a secret facility on [[Gorno]], and when the research base was relocated to another planet, the Hammertong was installed for transport in a massive hold aboard a specially-adapted [[Strike-class medium cruiser|''Strike''-class medium cruiser]].<ref name="Tong">{{StoryCite|story=Hammertong: The Tale of the "Tonnika Sisters"|book=Tales from the Mos Eisley Cantina}}</ref>

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], a scientist from the Hammertong project named [[Kellering]] approached a [[Mistryl Shadow Guard]] team led by [[Manda D'ulin]] about providing security for the prototype during transit. Ostensibly, Kellering claimed that Eloy was skeptical about the capabilities of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Drome]]'s security detail, but when he brought Manda to the base to meet Eloy, they were attacked by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and Manda was gunned down, followed shortly thereafter by her comrade [[Pav D'armon]].<ref name="Tong" />

The four surviving Mistryl responded by attacking the Imperials, determined to leave a message that the military could not simply shoot down Shadow Guards as they pleased. [[Shada D'ukal]] and [[Karoly D'ulin]] stole the Strike Cruiser, blasting out of orbit even as an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] arrived to guard the prototype.<ref name="Tong" />

The Mistryl escaped to Tatooine, where they hid the stolen cruiser beneath the sands of the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]], and Shada and Karoly headed into [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], disguised as the [[Tonnika sisters/Legends|Tonnika sisters]], to find a freighter that could transport part of the weapon back to [[Emberlene]]. They made contact with [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agent [[Riij Winward]], but quickly fell out over whether details of the Hammertong should go first to the Shadow Guard or the Alliance. The Mistryl ended up with their freighter, but Winward stole their astromech [[D4|Deefour]], along with a technical readout of the device - promising politely to return it once the Alliance had acquired the information.<ref name="Tong" />

==Behind the scenes==
Project Hammertong made its first appearance in the short story ''[[Hammertong: The Tale of the "Tonnika Sisters"]]''. It later received mentions in other sources, such as ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''.
